title: WE ARE HAPPY FROM CASAMASSIMA #HAPPYDAY
Pharrell Williams - Happy ( VINIŠĆE, Croatia )
description:
Happy VINIŠĆE

Video spot made in beautiful Croatian place Vinišće, inspired by Pharrell Williams song HAPPY.

Vinisce is a small quiet fishing town located in a beautiful bay of clear sea and untouched nature, only 12 km from Trogir.

Vinišće was first mentioned in documents from the Trogir landed estates in 1272, even though the time of establishment has not been completely investigated. Judging by the Illyrian structures and remains of Roman constructions, it was inhabited even earlier. During the middle ages, the area was divided into a Diocese, the southern part along the sea, and Opatija -- the northern inland part.

The town has several beautiful churches. The church of the Blessed Virgin Mary (St. George) in Orihovica was established by the benedictions in 1272. Surrounding it is an old cemetery with stone sarcophagi. The Church of St. Antun Padovanski (Lady of Carmella) was built in the 18th century in Vinišće itself. The new parish church of The Heart of Jesus has a painting from an unknown painter from the 9th century. The church of St. Ivan on the Ploče cape was built in 1332 according to the legend where the Blessed Ivan Trogir miraculously saved people from Šibenik whose ship sunk.

In the surroundings there are several beautiful bays well known for their attractive pebble and sand beaches -- Voluja, Ričevo Vrelo, Stari Trogir, Sićenica. Vinišće has several markets, restaurants, cafe bars, and a small marine for yachtsmen.

The place has a small ACI marine, restaurants and cafés, and a short drive can get you to the city of Split, the cultural center of Dalmatia. Vinišće is a place intended first of all for lovers of quiet family vacations in private rooms, apartments, and houses and the destination is suitable for those who wish to have their privacy.

Concerning activities, along with swimming and sunbathing, we can recommend surfing, sport and underwater fishing, and boat excursions. For those who love entertainment and night life, we recommend visiting nearby Trogir, Šibenik, Rogoznica, and Split.

title: Happy Messina - (Official Messina Video) #HAPPYDAY
description:
Impostare 1080p  dalla rotellina sulla barra per guardare il video in HD

Happy di Pharrell Williams. Il video è stato  realizzato dall'Associazione cinquE20 Messina, con la collaborazione di tutta Messina. 
Il video è stato girato in diversi punti caratteristici della città ed ha visto la partecipazione attiva di diversi piccoli e grandi imprenditori Messinesi che insieme a tanta altra gente hanno voluto sottolineare il messaggio fondamentale, che se si vuole, uniti, possiamo rendere la nostra meravigliosa città un po' più "HAPPY". 
Le riprese sono durate due settimane e i ragazzi di cinquE20 hanno percorso a piedi in lungo e in largo ogni angolo di Messina, coinvolgendo chiunque avesse voglia di mettersi in gioco con loro. Un'esperienza meravigliosa che è servita al gruppo a conoscere meglio non solo Messina ma anche e soprattutto chi la vive. 
CinquE20 è una nuova realtà di Messina che tenta di metter insieme più persone dando la possibilità a tutti di esser protagonisti della propria città, una palestra di talenti, dal ballo al canto, dalla fotografia all'animazione, pronta a crescere giorno dopo giorno anche grazie all'aiuto attivo dei tanti Supporters. 

Per seguire tutti gli eventi cinquE20 o realizzarne uno personalizzato visita il sito: www.cinque20.com o visita la pagina facebook: Cinque20 Messina.

description:
HAPPY - ROMA  - ROME 
" HAPPY in ROMA  - the eternal city " è il nuovo progetto firmato K&C Studios, in cui la voglia di essere "felici" risulta al primo posto. Il video mostra la città eterna:  i suoi monumenti, i suoi abitanti e i suoi turisti. In pochi minuti e sotto le note di HAPPY, il noto brano di Pharrell Williams, lo spettatore si immergerà in una dimensione parallela e spensierata tra i sorrisi dei partecipanti e le immagini immortali di Roma. Messaggio fondamentale alla base di questo video è che anche se la vita attuale risulta un po' grigia a causa della crisi, un po' di colore non fa di certo male.

Successful people have a social responsibility to make the world a better place and not just take from it.

 Carrie Underwood 


Each morning when I open my eyes I say to myself: I, not events, have the power to make me happy or unhappy today. I can choose which it shall be. Yesterday is dead, tomorrow hasn't arrived yet. I have just one day, today, and I'm going to be happy in it.

- Groucho Marx


The best feeling in the world is realising that you're perfectly happy without the thing you thought you needed

- marxie 

When I was in grade school, they told me to write down what I wanted to be when I grew up. 
I wrote down happy. 
They told me I didn't understand the assignment, 
I told them they didn't understand life


Being happy doesn't mean you're perfect. It just means you've decided to look beyond the imperfections

- K.B Indiana (age 14) 

If you think sunshine brings you happiness, then you haven't danced in the rain.

"People are just as happy as they make up their minds to be." ― Abraham Lincoln

"Count your age by friends, not years. Count your life by smiles, not tears." ― John Lennon

"The most important thing is to enjoy your life—to be happy—it's all that matters." ― Audrey Hepburn

There is no cosmetic for beauty like happiness. ~Lady Blessington

"Learn to value yourself, which means: fight for your happiness." ― Ayn Rand

I think the key to life is just being a happy person, and happiness will bring you success. ~Diego Val

Happiness is a by-product of an effort to make someone else happy. ~Gretta Brooker Palmer

You cannot always have happiness, but you can always give happiness.  ~Author Unknown

Happy - Pharrell Williams (We Are Happy From Lille)
description:
Melting box est une association à but non lucratif créée en 2009 qui a pour but de créer des événements originaux en mélangeant les arts et les styles. 

Melting box : https://www.facebook.com/pages/Melting-Box/359361460784007?fref=ts

Nous avons le plaisir de vous partager la vidéo "WE ARE HAPPY FROM LILLE". 

Celle ci était initialement prévue sur une journée mais comme vous l'avez vu sur la vidéo la pluie a décidé de s'en mêlé et nous avons décider de réorganiser une autre journée de tournage. 

La météo n'a pas entamé la motivation de certains et nous saluons ceux qui ont répondu présent malgré la pluie. 

Nous remercions tous les participants également ceux qui étaient hors caméra. 

N'hésitez pas à partager. 

Pour ceux qui désirent nous rencontrer, retrouvez nous le 25 avril 2014 au Comédia (151 Rue Solférino) pour la première édition du festival FREAKY WEEK :

Slideshow
_____________________

No dia 29 de março, mais de 200 pessoas mostraram a essência de Leiria! Percorrendo os locais históricos e turísticos, a sua população, desde os netos aos avós, com a sua disposição alegre e descontraída, mostrou o que faz de Leiria uma das melhores cidades para se viver em Portugal!!
Muito obrigado a todos.. e façam o favor de ser FELIZES! :)
We are Happy from LEIRIA

_____________________________________________________

On March 29, over 200 people demonstrated the essence of Leiria! Walking through the historical and touristic places of the city, each habitant, from grandchildren to grandparents, with a great cheerful and relaxed spirit, showed what makes Leiria one of the best places to live in Portugal!
Thank you all... and be happy!
WE ARE HAPPY FROM LEIRIA

title: Pharrell Williams - HAPPY BRATISLAVA
description:
SLOVENSKY: Nápad spraviť video Happy Bratislava sa nám vnukol sám. Aj tím bol zostavený okamžite. Termín natáčania nám poradila predpoveď počasia: 13.3 a 14.3.2014, priam letné počasie s krásnou modrou oblohou. 
Pozvali sme sa zúčastniť všetkých, čo sme poznali, ale odozva nebola práve ohromujúca. Veľká časť oslovených nám nakoniec účasť odriekla, a tým vytvorili miesto pre naozaj "náhodných" tanečníkov z ulice, ktorých sme naverbovali priamo na mieste natáčania. Vždy sme potrebovali ľudí najprv prehovárať, ale keď už začali tancovať, boli takí unesení silou piesne, že už sa potom nevedeli zastaviť. Tešíme sa najmä z autenticity nášho videa. Ide z neho naozaj tá pravá pozitívna energia, ktorá vyžaruje z piesne.
Nech vám naše video Happy Bratislava vyčaruje úsmev na tvári, pretože "robením si starostí" ešte žiadna starosť nezmizla. Život je tak krásny ako si ho krásny urobíme. Každý deň. Tu a teraz.
Poďakovanie: všetkým happy ľudom v Bratislave

DEUTSCH: Die Idee das Video Happy Bratislava zu drehen kam "wie von selbst".  Auch das Team war sofort zusammengestellt. Der Drehtermin ergab sich aus der Wettervorhersage: am 13.3 und 14.3.2014 sollte sommerliches Wetter mit Sonnenschein und blauem Himmel sein.
Wir haben alle Freunde und Bekannte eingeladen an dem Dreh teilzunehmen, aber die Resonanz was nicht überwältigend. Viele angesprochenen haben am Ende ihre Teilnahme abgesagt, und dadurch Platz geschaffen für wirklich "Zufällige" Tänzer von der Straße, die wir direkt während des Drehs angeworben hatten. Am Anfang mussten wir die Leute überreden zu tanzen, aber nach dem sie angefangen haben, wurden sie von der Kraft des Liedes so überwältigt, das sie nicht mehr aufhören wollten. Uns freut vor allen die Authentizität unseres Videos. Es strömt aus ihm genau die positive Energie aus, die auch im Lied ist.
Möge das Video Happy Bratislava ihnen ein Lächeln auf ihr Gesicht zaubern, denn mit "sich Sorgen machen" ist noch nie eine Sorge verschwunden. Das Leben ist schön, wenn wir uns es schön machen. Jeden Tag. Hier und Jetzt.

title: HAPPY ANTIGONISH 2014
description:
After an unusually long and difficult winter on the east coast of Canada, Antigonish decided to inject some positive energy into their town. On the morning of April 30th, downtown storefronts were decorated with paint on the windows, chalk on the sidewalks and clusters of yellow balloons.The iconic HAPPY song piped out onto Main Street.The energy completely changed. People danced in the street. The non-profit Antigonish Creative Dance Association also provided happy dancers and performed dance routines to the catchy tune. There was even some Heaven Nature Qigong performed (move titled "Boat Rowing in a Stream of Air"). That evening, people congregated at the People's Place library for a Happy Event that included a fashion show, free food and prizes from local merchants.The following sunrise, fishermen were piped out to sea with happiness to commence the opening of the lobster season. Thank you Pharrell Williams for giving Antigonish the inspiration get HAPPY! We are pleased to be part of the global happy family www.wearehappyfrom.com

Find out more about ACALATV: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OXix4IjEPD0

title: Pharrell Williams - Happy - Aachen (Karneval Edition, RWTH/JLU Students) #HAPPYDAY
description:
Vieeeeelen Dank an alle, die in diesem Video mitgewirkt haben! Aachen is also happy :D. Viel Spaß! 
Be happy :-)))

Wir sind keine professionellen Tänzer. Wir gehören keiner Tanzschule, Zeitung, keinem Ferseh- oder Radiosender an. Dieses Video war eine private Initiative, um auch die Happy Aachener zu zeigen :-). Von den 29 im Video mitwirkenden Personen sind 8 (einschließlich mir) Freunde. Die restlichen 21 Menschen sind Passanten, die ich auf der Straße angesprochen habe. Die Passanten haben sich sofort bereit erklärt, bei so einem tollen Projekt mitzuwirken, Happy zu sein und Aachen als eine fröhliche Stadt zu repräsentieren. Dieses Video ist ein weiteres Glied in der Kette von bis dato 600 Happy-Videos aus 84 Ländern, um Menschen auf der Welt mit der Happy-Botschaft von Pharrell Williams zu verbinden.

In dem Sinne, nicht vergessen: Am 20.03 ist der "International Day of Happiness" #happyday

title: We are happy from Marijampolė
description:
Atsinaujinusį miestą pavasariškame vaizdo įraše „Happy from Marijampolė" pristato ir marijampoliečiai. Trijų minučių klipe filmavosi daugiau nei 100 marijampoliečių: oficiali miesto futbolo komanda, baikerių klubas, pop atlikėjai, sporto kolektyvai, jaunimo organizacijos, šeimos. 
Iniciatyvos sukurti profesionalų video ėmėsi asociacija „Marijampoliečiai" -- nevyriausybinė jaunimo organizacija, vienijanti aktyvius ir pilietiškus žmones, siekianti skleisti objektyvią informaciją apie visuomenėje vykstančius procesus Marijampolėje ir Lietuvoje bei jų įtaką žmonėms. Organizacijos tikslas -- ugdyti pilietiškus, visuomeniškai aktyvius, kritiškai mąstančius žmones regione. description:
The secret's out! It was us Digicel Jamaica we're glad you like this remarkable video that was created to make you smile. #JamaicaHappy

Over the course of two days, Film Director, Jay Will along with Kimala Bennett from The Production Lab, travelled across Jamaica with members of Digicel's Marketing team to capture footage of people from different walks of life who all have one thing in common -- they're happy. 

It's not every day we get to work on something that shows such an unfiltered and pure expression of our country, our enthusiasm for such a project is probably only matched by the enthusiasm by which it was received.

We are one of the county's largest employers, with approximately 10,000 full- and part-time employees.

Après Paris, Lyon, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Sydney, New York, nous sommes heureux de vous présenter le Happy "we are from Brussels"

5 jours de tournage, des heures de montage, une centaine de bruxellois filmés dans les 4 coins de la Capitale, l'aube, le jour, la nuit, sous le soleil mais aussi bravant le froid piquant et la pluie, voici ENFIN le résultat de notre travail : Un clip-hommage rendu à Bruxelles et au Bruxellois sur le son addictif du patron, Pharrell Williams - un énorme merci à lui !!!.

Cette expérience inoubliable, ces rencontres improbables et extraordinaires nous ont confirmé tout ce qu'on pensait déjà savoir sur Bruxelles et ses habitants, les deux sont : colorés, beaux, joueurs, cools, surprenants, décomplexés, débordant d'une énergie de fou,... 

Un grand merci à la centaine de bruxellois qui nous a fait cadeau de son côté happy en acceptant de se déhancher sur « HAPPY », malheureusement en 3min tout le monde ne s'y trouve pas, don't worry, nous passerons les rushes sur la page Ici#CestBxl au fur et à mesure.

Big up tout particulier à Strikt M. Smith et Marvin Gma pour leur travail d'artiste, aux jeunes qui ont déboulés à la Gare Centrale et nous ont offert une des plus belles et plus intenses scène du clip, aux danseurs de la Philadelphia Art School, Sarah Ftaich, et à tous les anonymes qui se sont laissés prendre par le groove irrésistible de Pharrell.

Dédicace spéciale à la Vice Première Ministre de l'intérieur #CestJoelle (Joelle Milquet, cdH) pour nous avoir fait l'honneur d'un petit claquement de doigt rythmé.
Et enfin, à tous nos amis qui ont également donné de leur personne, dans l'ordre d'apparition :
Grégory Dahan: organisateur, harceleur, chef de projet, agenda humain, chauffeur, livreur de durum
Fiston Freddy Mayele - Trésor Diamp - Loubna Azghoud - Murielle Koch - Sofia Bennani - 
Marius Ndolimana - Christel Putman - Youssef Lakhloufi - Sarah Yagoub - Christophe de Beukelaer - Oumayma Hammadi - Laurent Hacken - Othman Seghir - Lorenzo Harangozo - Serob Muradyan - Nico Patelli - Mahinur Ozdemir - Mounir Laarissi - Izabella Sobolewska

title: We Are Happy From #Camerota - #CILENTO - Full HD 1080p
description:
We Are Happy from #Camerota: videoclip realizzata dall'Associazione SOS Sorriso (www.facebook.com/AssociazioneSOSsorriso) in collaborazione con il portale turistico WebCilento.com (www.webcilento.com)

Music by Pharrel Williams

È la moda del momento: una canzone, luoghi familiari e tanti sorrisi per raccontare, in un video di quattro minuti, la Nostra Terra, la Nostra Tradizione e Noi stessi.

Chi, se non l'Assosiciazione SOS Sorriso, avrebbe potuto regalare questa emozione? Fatto dai Camerotani per Camerotani e non, abbiamo il piacere di presentare l'inedito WE ARE HAPPY FROM #CAMEROTA!

In tre parole: promozione, valorizzazione e divertimento.

Nella videoclip abbiamo riassunto alcune immagini rappresentative del nostro paese, nonchè l'arte (in particolare la musica) e l'artigianato che da sempre caratterizza Camerota.

Le riprese sono state realizzate in Full HD grazie al contributo dello staff di WebCilento.com

#HappyChallengeAccepted: lasciati contagiare dal sound del sorriso e, se ti va, lascia una tua recensione al video.

title: Pharrell Williams - Happy NOVO MESTO (Slovenia)
description:
V preteklih mesecih smo lahko velikokrat poslušali vesele ritme uspešnice Happy, ki jo poje Pharell Williams. Pesem govori o sreči in seveda kar kliče k temu, da si jo ljudje požvižgavajo in nanjo tudi zaplešejo.

Tudi v Plesnem studiu Novo mesto smo se odločili, da ustvarimo skupaj z MONM projekt »Happy Novo mesto«, pri katerem so sodelovali znani novomeščani, znani novomeški podjetji in seveda naši številčni plesalci. Ponosni smo, da je naš projekt podprla Mestna občina Novo mesto, Revoz d.d. in Adria Mobil, kajti namen projekta »Happy Novo mesto« je, da tudi ostalim predstavimo našo lepo dolenjsko prestolnico, na malo drugačen, zabaven način.

Projekt smo snemali v različnih terminih in na različnih značilnih novomeških lokacijah, zaključek projekta pa je potekal v nedeljo, 15.6.2014, ko smo zaplesali Happy na Glavnem in na Novem trgu. Prelepo vreme in pozitivna energija sta poskrbela za to, da sta bila oba novomeška trga preplavljena z našimi »happy« plesalci ter rumenimi baloni, katere smo na koncu spustili v nebo.

Mi smo srečni, da smo projekt uspešno izpeljali, predvsem pa smo veseli, da so se ljudje ob plesu zabavali, za trenutek pozabili na vsakdanje skrbi in ujeli svoj delček sreče. 

Hvala tudi vsem akterjem v videu...brez vaše udeležbe nebi uspel projekt :)

title: Happy Goes Mönchengladbach
description:
Song "Happy" written by Pharrell Williams
Published by Emi April Music, Inc. Obo itself and more water from Nazareth (ASCAP) / Universal Pictures Music (ASCAP).
Background vocals performed by Rhea Dummett, Trevon Henderson, Ashley L. Lee, Shamika Hightower, Jasmine Murray and Terrence Rolle. Produced by Pharrell Williams. Recorded by Mike Larson for I Am Other Entertainment at Circle House Studios, Miami, Fl. Assisted by Matthew Desrameaux. Digital editing and arrangement by Andrew Coleman and Mike Larson for I Am Other Entertainment. Mixed by Leslie Brathwaite at Music Box Studios, Atlanta, Ga.

Auf der ganzen Welt entstehen derzeit Musik-Videos zum Song „Happy" von US-Sänger und No.1 Produzent Pharrell Williams: In New York, Hongkong, Sidney und jetzt auch in Mönchengladbach, tanzen Menschen zu dem Gute-Laune-Lied durch die Straßen.

„Mönchengladbach ist nicht die tollste und beste Stadt, aber nun auch endlich happy", beschrieb ein Passant am Freitagnachmittag am Rande der Dreharbeiten seine Gefühle.

Tatsächlich ist die Idee, zu „Happy" von US-Künstler Pharrell Williams durch die Straßen der Stadt zu tanzen, nicht neu: Videos aus Sydney, Lyon, Hongkong, Berlin und anderen Großstädten fluteten in den vergangenen Tagen die Plattform Youtube.

Die Mönchengladbacher Version ist ab sofort u.a. hier zu bewundern. 

Produziert haben den Clip Christof Knops und Christian Görtz, zwei gebürtige und videobegeisterte Mönchengladbacher, die hinter Ihrer Stadt stehen und die zeigen wollen das es nicht nur die großen Städte sind, die solche Projekte stemmen können.

Und es gab sogar prominente Unterstützung: René Pütz, Frontmann der Gruppe Booster und Frank Nießen, Moderator des Stadtradios 90.1, schwingen die Hüften zum bekanntesten Ohrwurm dieser Tage. Für weitere Überraschungen ist gesorgt.

Uns ganz egal, wie viele Städte schneller waren -- das Gladbacher Herz macht beim Zusehen einen kräftigen Hüpfer.

title: We are HAPPY from Castrovillari   Pharrell Williams #Happyday
description:
ANCHE A CASTROVILLARI IMPAZZA L'ALLEGRIA CON "WE ARE HAPPY FROM" 
Anche Castrovillari, grazie all'associazione culturale Khoreia 2000, da un'idea di Marina Martino, Angela Micieli e Rosy Parrotta, ha risposto all'appello del cantante Pharrell Williams. L'iniziativa si chiama «We are happy from...» e culminerà nella giornata mondiale della felicità, fissata per il prossimo 20 marzo, con la collaborazione dell'Onu. La città del Pollino non poteva mancare. Ed ecco bambini, artisti, giovani, adulti e anziani pronti a sorridere in ogni dove. Con grande entusiasmo è stata realizzata una gioiosa video-cartolina di Castrovillari. Di questi tempi un sorriso è di certo la terapia migliore contro la crisi e i problemi quotidiani.

description:
l'Arte non veste in maniera sontuosa... Il Processo Creativo nasce in soffitta, nel garage, nei vicoli... Sulla spiaggia o nel Bosco... Il più delle volte l'Amata Ispirazione, concubina dell'Artista, giunge salendo la scala di grigi del Cuore... Ma non di rado capita
che giunga accompagnata anche dal Giallo calore del Sole della Felicità...

Questa volta vi accompagniamo in quei luoghi dove non solo l'Arte ma l'Amore e l'Amicizia si muovono, e lo facciamo danzando...

E ricordandovi che, in questo video, nessun Artista o Creativo ha subito maltrattamenti... 

Ps: non importa quanti video HAPPY siano stati girati e quanti ancora ne verranno prodotti...
Ben venga la Felicità in corpose dosi... Come diceva Anselmo Bucci? "Maledetta la sobrietà. Da noi si beve troppo poco spirito, per averne traccia"...

Origem do Dia
A criação do Dia Internacional da Felicidade surge por sugestão do Butão, um pequeno reino budista localizado nos Himalaias que adota como estatística oficial a "Felicidade Nacional Bruta" em vez do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB).Em 2012, a proposta foi aprovada por unanimidade pelos 193 estados-membros da ONU (Organização das Nações Unidas), defendendo que a busca pela felicidade é um objetivo humano fundamental.Importância da FelicidadeTodas as pessoas procuram a felicidade.
